name: Vegetable Risotto
steps: Keep measured water hot in a separate saucepan. Finely chop onion and garlic, slice mushrooms and dice zucchini.
Heat oil and half the butter in a wide pan. Soften onion for 5 minutes, add mushrooms for 6 minutes, then garlic and rice for 1–2 minutes until rice edges turn translucent.
Add a ladle of hot water and stir over medium-low heat until nearly absorbed. Continue adding water one ladle at a time, stirring frequently.
After 10 minutes add zucchini and peas. Continue adding hot water and cooking for another 8–12 minutes until the rice is tender with a slight bite; you may not need every drop.
Turn off heat and fold in remaining butter, grated vegetarian hard cheese, salt, pepper and lemon juice.
Rest for 2 minutes and serve while loose and creamy; risotto should flow gently on the plate rather than stand in a stiff mound.
tips: Rinse grains before cooking, use a heavy pan and rest covered before fluffing or serving.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
